title: Quick Sweet Gooey Dutch Butter Toast
description: A fast and easy-to-make pescatarian breakfast or dessert featuring sweet Dutch butter toast on a hot stone plate.
instructions:
Preheat the stone plate to 300	8F (150
C).
Place the slices of bread on the hot stone plate.
In a small bowl, mix together the Dutch butter and granulated sugar until smooth.
Spread the sugar butter mixture evenly over the bread slices.
Top each slice with a dollop of sour cream and a pinch of salt.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the sour cream is slightly golden brown and the bread is toasted.
Remove from heat and serve immediately.
Serve warm, garnished with additional sugar and sour cream if desired.
